blind.B1: No. GSE226005 is the human IMR90 fibroblast bulk RNA-seq SubSeries (senescent/young, hypoxia/normoxia, 2-DG) of SuperSeries GSE226008 (DA.p1). No exercise words in any metadata column. The exercise arm (running vs sedentary mouse gastrocnemius, snRNA-seq; S2.7, FIG7, S5.2, S5.15) is not in this series. No sequenced sample here carries the exercise factor.
blind.B2: Exercise: running vs sedentary female mice, n=2 per group (snRNA-seq, FIG7), not in this series. In this series: Senescent vs Young, Hypoxia vs Normoxia, 2-DG+Hypoxia vs Hypoxia control, 2 samples each (FIG2, S5.12).
blind.B3: No repeated measures in the 12 IMR90 samples; candidate keys in packet A pair nothing (grp duplicates in every level, title-based key links 4/12). Not relevant to the refusal.
blind.B4: Paper does not state joint vs pairwise fit; bulk IMR90 data processed with featureCounts + DESeq2 normalization (S5.12.p1).
blind.B5: Bulk IMR90 (S5.12.p1): |log2(FC)| > 1 or 0.58 and adjusted P < 0.05. Exercise snRNA-seq (S5.15.p1): Wilcoxon FindMarkers, |log2FC| > 0.25 and adjusted P < 0.05 per cell type; global |log2FC| > 0.15 and adjusted P < 0.05. DEG counts only in Figure S30B, not in text.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm in GSE226005 (packet A: no exercise words, all IMR90); paper S2.7/S5.15 place exercise data in mouse snRNA-seq outside this series.
No contrast run; grp parsed from title gives 6 levels of n=2 consistent with FIG2 design.
No repeated-measure structure; packet A keys link no samples across levels.
No exercise factor; matrix normalized per experiment batch is noted in the matrix gate.
Matrix gate records non-integer DESeq2-normalized values (integer_fraction 0.0058), consistent with data_processing and S5.12.p1.
Recorded exercise rule FDR<0.05, |log2FC|>0.25 (global 0.15) matches S5.15.p1; bulk IMR90 rule noted separately and marked not applicable.
HANDBACK claims no DEG counts and does not overclaim; paper counts only in Fig S30B.

Reason 'no exercise contrast' is true and established from metadata of all 12 samples, titles and the paper's data locations. Suitability 'sample_size' fail is a mechanical side flag, not the stated reason.

human_items: Open policy question: the exercise snRNA-seq SubSeries of GSE226008 was not examined; whether to route it as a separate case is for the person.
summary: 该系列为人IMR90成纤维细胞bulk RNA-seq(衰老、缺氧、2-DG),不含运动组,拒绝分析的理由成立且依据充分。阈值、矩阵类型和HANDBACK表述均与论文一致,未发现需要修改的项目。
